title: Revit Documentation and Export Preparation
purpose: Prepare repeatable Revit documentation and exchange outputs using governed export views, naming authority, settings, and evidence without allowing draft source examples to override S3/S4/S7 requirements.

applies_to.scope: PDF, NWC, IFC, and RVT output preparation

preconditions: The intended deliverable or coordination output is defined under S7 or the applicable project exchange requirement.
The current naming and folder authority under S3/S4 is available.
Dedicated export views or governed output sets exist where required.
Any tool-specific export preset used has a governed source or is explicitly project-approved.

steps.name: Prepare governed output scope
actions: Identify the output purpose, format, discipline/scope, and applicable issue state.
Select the governed sheet set or dedicated export view rather than an arbitrary working view.
Confirm the export view controls categories, filters, linked-model visibility, phase, design option, and detail level as required by the output purpose.
validation: The selected output scope is traceable to a declared deliverable or coordination purpose.
Working-view state is not used accidentally as an exchange definition.
failure_modes: An arbitrary working view is exported.
The output scope does not match the declared exchange purpose.

steps.name: Apply governed naming and destination
actions: Name output files using the current governed S4 identity/naming rule or project-approved mapping.
Place outputs in the governed S3/S7 production, coordination, or publication location appropriate to their state.
Do not use source-page example filename or folder patterns where they conflict with current canonical registries.
validation: Output identity resolves through the governed naming source.
Destination matches the output lifecycle/state under S3/S7.
failure_modes: A draft example pattern is treated as canonical naming authority.
An output is placed in a location implying an incorrect lifecycle or acceptance state.

steps.name: Prepare PDF output
actions: Export the governed sheet set using the approved project/template PDF configuration where one exists.
Preserve required vector/raster, font, lineweight, and print-quality behavior defined by the governed configuration.
Test representative output for legibility before formal issue.
validation: PDF output is legible and consistent with the approved sheet/view presentation.
The export configuration is traceable where the project requires it.
failure_modes: Unapproved local PDF settings materially change the output.
Fonts, graphics, or lineweights render incorrectly.

steps.name: Prepare coordination or open exchange
actions: For NWC, use the governed Navisworks export instruction and applicable preset/settings source.
For IFC, use the project-approved IFC version, exchange scope, phase/design-option handling, and property-set mapping; do not infer defaults from draft source examples.
Use governed shared-coordinate behavior where spatial alignment is required.
validation: The exported file opens in the intended consuming environment.
Spatial alignment and required properties are preserved for the declared purpose.
failure_modes: An ungoverned IFC version/MVD or export preset is assumed.
Coordinate or property behavior differs from the declared exchange requirement.

steps.name: Record export evidence
actions: Record output identity, source model/container, export timestamp, application/exporter version, settings or preset identity where applicable, and responsible role.
Retain validation evidence required by the applicable coordination or submission workflow.
validation: The output can be traced to the source container and export configuration/context.
Creation of an export is not represented as formal acceptance unless the applicable S7 process grants that state.
failure_modes: An export cannot be reproduced or traced.
File creation is mistaken for acceptance or contractual issue.

outputs: Prepared PDF, NWC, IFC, or RVT output appropriate to declared purpose
future_dependencies: Governed PDF export configuration/preset where required
Governed IFC export configuration/preset and exchange mapping where required
governance_notes: The source page is explicitly draft; its filename patterns, folder scaffold, PDF numeric settings, NWC settings, and IFC default examples are not promoted where current S3/S4/S7 authority is stronger or the source contains TODOs.
The concrete Navisworks export instruction remains the tool-specific governed-values source for NWC behavior already migrated.
Export creation is evidence of execution, not acceptance or reliance.

provenance.migration_note: Draft documentation/export source normalized to L6. Source examples and TODO configuration values were not promoted; current S3/S4/S7 authority and the concrete Navisworks instruction govern instead.
